messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates are in the local time zone for each province/territory; the federal holidays apply nationwide):

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Federal holiday – falls on a Sunday, so the observed day is Monday, January 2. |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Observed on the third Monday in February. |
| **March 17** | Friday | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Observed on the last Friday in March. |
| **April 7** | Monday | Good Friday | Federal holiday – observed on the Friday before Easter Sunday. |
| **April 10** | Thursday | Easter Monday (Quebec, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Yukon) | Observed on the Monday after Easter Sunday. |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day (all provinces except Quebec) | Observed on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **June 19** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Yukon) | Observed on the first Monday in June. |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Federal holiday – falls on a Saturday, so the observed day is Monday, July 3. |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Observed on the first Monday in August. |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | Federal holiday – observed on the first Monday in September. |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Observed on the second Monday in October. |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day (all provinces) | Observed on the second Monday in November. |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Federal holiday – observed on the Monday itself. |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Federal holiday – observed on the Tuesday itself. |

**Long‑weekends** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break) in 2023:

- **New Year’s Day** – Jan 1 (Sunday) → observed Mon 2
- **Family Day** – Feb 20 (Monday)
- **St. Patrick’s Day** – Mar 17 (Friday)
- **Good Friday** – Apr 7 (Monday)
- **Easter Monday** – Apr 10 (Thursday) – not a long weekend
- **Victoria Day** – May 22 (Monday)
- **National Indigenous Peoples Day** – Jun 19 (Monday)
- **Canada Day** – Jul 1 (Saturday) → observed Mon 3
- **Civic Holiday** – Aug 7 (Monday)
- **Labour Day** – Sep 18 (Monday)
- **Thanksgiving** – Oct 9 (Monday)
- **Remembrance Day** – Nov 7 (Monday)
- **Christmas Day** – Dec 25 (Monday)
- **Boxing Day** – Dec 26 (Tuesday) – not a long weekend

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need additional details!
